'''Thermal suits'''<ref name="SWS" /> or '''thermasuits'''<ref name="SBS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref> were items of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] that were used to protect from cold weather. They were sold throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], usually in large [[City/Legends|cities]] and at [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] for four hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="SWS" />

They were seen on [[Akuria II]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
